integrity: An analytic all-order proof and a standalone finite checker are supplied; the latter is corroboration, not a proof of all integer orders. No independent external verification was performed.
scientific_limitations: Exact formulas cover ordinary unweighted shortest-path distance on Möbius ladders; the sharp powered-negative-type exponent below one and fixed-bandwidth Gaussian positivity islands are not established. Historical equivalences may remain undiscovered.
title: Pell–power parity and exact Fourier inertia of Möbius-ladder geodesic matrices
